title: Surcharge on a domestic company's income-tax
description: The surcharge for the purposes of the Union on a domestic company's income-tax for tax years from 2026-27, by the income-tax it is levied on and the company's total income, with the marginal relief the Finance Act gives, each in the instrument's words: Paragraph F of Part I-B of the First Schedule to the Finance Act, 2026, the Table of its section 3(4)(b), as amended from 1 April 2026 by section 6 of the Taxation and Other Laws (Amendment) Act, 2026, whose Sl. No. 8 levies 25% on tax under section 195(1)(i), and its section 3(6), which adds 12% to tax charged at the rates of sections 69, 170(5) and 352. Part III and section 3(12) state the same bands for advance tax, none for section 3(6); the words are those of the tax charged for the tax year. The bands are for the tax year 2026-27 alone, so every row ends on 31 March 2027. Only the bands of Paragraph F and of Sl. No. 6 turn on the total income. The tax period is the tax year, and the set answers for its first day.

instruments: Finance Act, 2026 (No. 4 of 2026), 30 March 2026, sections 3(4), 3(5), 3(6), 3(12) and 3(13) and First Schedule, Part I-B, Paragraph F and Part III, Paragraph F, in force 1 April 2026 (section 1(2)(a))

Taxation and Other Laws (Amendment) Act, 2026 (No. 21 of 2026), 17 August 2026, section 6, substituting serial numbers 9 and 9A for serial number 9 in the Tables of sections 3(4)(b) and 3(12)(b) of the Finance Act, 2026, deemed in force 1 April 2026 (section 1(2))
Finance Act, 2026 (No. 4 of 2026), long title: “An Act to give effect to the financial proposals of the Central Government for the financial year 2026-27.”

Finance Act, 2026 (No. 4 of 2026), section 3(1): “for the tax year commencing on the 1st day of April, 2026, income-tax shall be charged” at the rates of Part I-B of the First Schedule “and such tax shall be increased by a surcharge, for the purposes of the Union, calculated in each case in the manner provided therein”

Finance Act, 2026 (No. 4 of 2026), section 3(10)(iv), which computes the advance tax payable under Chapter XIX-C of the Income-tax Act, 2025 at the rates of Part III of the First Schedule; that Act's section 2(90)(a)(iii) makes the rates in force for it “the rate or rates of income-tax specified in this behalf in the Finance Act of the relevant year”

cells.name: Total income above ₹1 crore up to ₹10 crore, on tax under Paragraphs A to E
cells.wording: The amount of income-tax computed in accordance with Paragraphs A to E, or the provisions of section 196, 197 or 198 of the said Act, in the case of person as specified in column B in Table 1 below, shall be increased by a surcharge, for the purposes of the Union, calculated at the rate or rates as specified in column C of the said Table, of such income-tax. [Table 1: Sl. No. 5.C] (i) Where the total income exceeds ₹ 10000000 but does not exceed ₹ 100000000, at the rate of 7%;
cells.marginalRelief: Further, in respect of the persons mentioned in column B of the Table 2 below, having total income exceeding the amount as specified in column C of the said Table but does not exceed the amount specified in column D thereof, the total amount payable as income-tax and surcharge thereon shall not exceed the amount determined as per the following formula:— Wn = Un + Vn where,–– Wn = the total amount beyond which the total amount payable as income-tax and surcharge thereon shall not exceed; Un = the total amount payable as income-tax and surcharge, if applicable, on an amount as specified in column C of the Table 2 below; and Vn = the total income – amount as specified in column C of the said Table. [Table 2: Sl. No. 5] Table 1: Sl. Nos. 5.B and 6.B. ₹1,00,00,000. ₹ 10,00,00,000.

cells.name: Tax charged at the rates of section 69, 170(5) or 352
cells.persons: In cases in which tax has to be charged and paid under section 69 or section 170(5) or section 352 of the said Act
cells.wording: (6) In cases in which tax has to be charged and paid under section 69 or section 170(5) or section 352 of the said Act, the tax shall be charged and paid at the rates as specified in those sections and shall be increased by a surcharge, for the purposes of the Union, calculated at the rate of 12% of such tax.
